dev.tanrei.vocabulary.rationale: One product shows a color that is not an input — a brand color in its settings, a label color beside a label, a theme’s roles side by side — as a sample with its name: small beside a line of text, at a row’s height, and larger where the color itself is looked at; as a square tile or as a dot; over a checkerboard where the color lets what is behind it through, and edged so that a color close to the surface around it still shows where it ends.

dev.tanrei.llm.usage: Everything a swatch reads: per size, the side of its sample, the gap between the sample and its text and the text styles of its label and supporting text; per shape, the sample’s corners; the checkerboard drawn under a color that is not opaque; the hairline that edges the sample; the colors of the two texts.
rules: A swatch shows a color; it is not a control. It takes no press and no focus and has no states. A set of swatches of which one is chosen is a picker, not this component.

A color is never told by its sample alone: give every swatch a label (its name, "Teal 600"), drawn beside the sample by default. Hide it (labelHidden) only where space forbids text; then it is the sample’s accessible name. Mark a swatch decorative where the same name already stands beside it in text.
The swatch draws the color exactly: nothing is mixed into it, in any scheme, and forced colors keep it.
Restyle through these tokens in a layer; never draw a color sample by hand.

small.$description: The side of a small sample: beside one line of small text, in a table cell or a dense row.

medium.$description: The side of a medium sample: beside a line of body text, in a list row or a setting.

large.$description: The side of a large sample: where the color itself is looked at, in a palette or a theme’s overview.

square.$description: The corners of a square sample, never more than half its side: a slightly rounded square in the default system.

circle.$description: The corners of a circle sample: a dot.

color.$description: One of the two colors of the checkerboard drawn under the color, which shows through a color that is not opaque and is covered by one that is.

alternate-color.$description: The other color of the checkerboard, for every second square.

size.$description: The side of one square of the checkerboard.

width.$description: The width of the sample’s edge, drawn inside its size, over the color.

color.$description: The sample’s edge: the one hairline, the color the divider draws its line in. It bounds a sample whose color is close to the surface around it, and it is all an empty sample draws. The swatch’s text carries the meaning, so the edge is not held to a contrast ratio.

small.$description: Between a small sample and its text.

medium.$description: Between a medium sample and its text.

large.$description: Between a large sample and its text.

color.$description: The color’s name, beside the sample.
The line under the name: the color’s value, a token’s name, where it is used.
